LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Enlist_Letter_Label: The colony has pledged itself to the Mane. Khajiit of every clan will treat you as a friend of Elsweyr.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Enlist_Button_Desc: Join the clans of Elsweyr under the Mane. The sands are hot, the trade is good.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Enlist_Requrements_Not_Sati: The clans of Elsweyr do not know you. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Faction: Elsweyr does not accept the pledge of its enemies.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Missions_Desc: See what the clans want done.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Menu_Missions_Desc: Errands for the clans of Elsweyr. Khajiit pays when the work is done.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Provisions_Desc: Dried meat and sweet bread from the caravans.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Storage_Desc: Leave goods with a Khajiit caravan.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Resign_Menu_Text: Leave the Mane's service? The clans will remember.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony no longer serves the Mane.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Resign_Button_Desc: End your pledge to the Mane.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Kick_Out_Label_Title: The clans of Elsweyr have turned their backs on the colony.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Salary_Desc: A share of the clans' caravan profits.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Work_0_Desc: Ride with the caravans and help strike a good bargain.
LanguageData.ESCP_Elsweyr_Work_1_Desc: Learn the claw and the blade from the Mane's warriors.
